∃ (board : Fin 8 → Fin 8 → Bool) (coloring : Fin 8 → Fin 8 → ℕ) (queen_pos : Fin 8 × Fin 8),
    
    (∀ i j, board i j = True → 
      
      (∀ i' j', board i' j' = True → 
        (i' = i ∧ j' = j) ∨ 
        (i' = i ∧ j' ≠ j) ∨ 
        (i' ≠ i ∧ j' = j) ∨ 
        (i' ≠ i ∧ j' ≠ j ∧ (i' + j' = i + j ∨ i' - j' = i - j)) → 
        (i' = i ∧ j' = j) ∨ 
        (i' ≠ i ∨ j' ≠ j) ∨ 
        (i' + j' ≠ i + j) ∨ 
        (i' - j' ≠ i - j)) ∧
      
      (∀ i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂, board i₁ j₁ = True → board i₂ j₂ = True → 
        ((i₁ = i₂ ∧ (j₁ + 1 = j₂ ∨ j₁ - 1 = j₂)) ∨ 
         (j₁ = j₂ ∧ (i₁ + 1 = i₂ ∨ i₁ - 1 = i₂)) ∨ 
         (i₁ + j₁ = i₂ + j₂ ∧ i₁ - j₁ = i₂ - j₂)) → 
        coloring i₁ j₁ ≠ coloring i₂ j₂)) ∧
    
    (∀ i j, coloring i j ∈ ({1, 2, 3} : Set ℕ)) ∧
    
    board queen_pos.1 queen_pos.2 = True

∃ (grid : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℕ),
  
  (∀ i j, grid i j = 0 ∨ grid i j = 1) ∧
  
  (∀ i, ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), ∀ j, grid i j = (σ j).val + 1) ∧
  
  (∀ j, ∃ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), ∀ i, grid i j = (τ i).val + 1) ∧
  
  (∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => grid i j = 1)).sum (fun j => (j.val + 1)) = 
    if i = 0 then 6 else if i = 1 then 7 else if i = 2 then 5 else if i = 3 then 9 else 8) ∧
  
  (∀ j, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => grid i j = 1)).sum (fun i => (i.val + 1)) = 
    if j = 0 then 12 else if j = 1 then 10 else if j = 2 then 8 else if j = 3 then 7 else 6)

∃ (assignment : Fin 7 → Bool) (grid : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 7),
    
    (∀ s : Fin 7, assignment s ↔ 
      (assignment s = true ↔ (Finset.filter (fun p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 => grid p.1 p.2 = s) Finset.univ).card > 3)) ∧
    
    (∀ i : Fin 5, (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun j => (if grid i j = 0 then 0 else 1)) : ℕ) = 5) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 5, (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => (if grid i j = 0 then 0 else 1)) : ℕ) = 5) ∧
    
    (∀ i j, grid i j < 7)

∃ (grid : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℕ) (coloring : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 3),
  
  (∀ i j, grid i j = 0 ∨ grid i j = 1) ∧
  
  (∀ i : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.sum fun j => grid i j * (j.val + 1)) = 
    if i.val = 0 then 4
    else if i.val = 1 then 4
    else if i.val = 2 then 3
    else 5) ∧
  
  (∀ j : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.sum fun i => grid i j * (i.val + 1)) = 
    if j.val = 0 then 2
    else if j.val = 1 then 4
    else if j.val = 2 then 9
    else 1) ∧
  
  (∀ i j : Fin 4, grid i j = 1 → grid (i + 1) j = 1 → coloring i j ≠ coloring (i + 1) j) ∧
  (∀ i j : Fin 4, grid i j = 1 → grid i (j + 1) = 1 → coloring i j ≠ coloring i (j + 1))

∃ (coloring : Fin 10 → ℕ),
  
  (∀ i, coloring i ∈ ({1, 2, 3} : Set ℕ)) ∧
  
  (∀ i j, (i, j) ∈ ({(0, 1), (0, 7), (0, 9), (1, 4), (2, 4), 
               (3, 5), (3, 6), (6, 8), (7, 9)} : Set (Fin 10 × Fin 10)) → 
   coloring i ≠ coloring j) ∧
  
  
  let row_weight (i : Fin 10) := (i.val % 4) + 1
  let col_weight (i : Fin 10) := (i.val / 4) + 1
  
  (∑ i : Fin 10, if i.val % 5 = 0 then coloring i * row_weight i else 0) = 10 ∧
  (∑ i : Fin 10, if i.val % 5 = 1 then coloring i * row_weight i else 0) = 2 ∧
  (∑ i : Fin 10, if i.val % 5 = 2 then coloring i * row_weight i else 0) = 1 ∧
  (∑ i : Fin 10, if i.val % 5 = 3 then coloring i * row_weight i else 0) = 3 ∧
  (∑ i : Fin 10, if i.val % 5 = 4 then coloring i * row_weight i else 0) = 2 ∧
  
  (∑ i : Fin 10, if i.val % 4 = 0 then coloring i * col_weight i else 0) = 4 ∧
  (∑ i : Fin 10, if i.val % 4 = 1 then coloring i * col_weight i else 0) = 8 ∧
  (∑ i : Fin 10, if i.val % 4 = 2 then coloring i * col_weight i else 0) = 5 ∧
  (∑ i : Fin 10, if i.val % 4 = 3 then coloring i * col_weight i else 0) = 1

(∃ (coloring : vertices → Fin 3),
    ∀ u v : vertices, adjacent u v → coloring u ≠ coloring v)

let zoeys_claim := fun (zoeys_type arias_type : Bool) => 
    zoeys_type → (¬zoeys_type ∨ ¬arias_type)
  let arias_claim := fun (zoeys_type arias_type : Bool) => 
    ¬zoeys_type
  
  ∃ (zoeys_type arias_type : Bool),
    zoeys_type = false ∧ arias_type = false ∧
    zoeys_claim zoeys_type arias_type ∧
    arias_claim zoeys_type arias_type

∃ (grid : Fin 8 → Fin 8 → Fin 8),
  (∀ i : Fin 8, Function.Bijective (fun j => grid i j)) ∧
  (∀ j : Fin 8, Function.Bijective (fun i => grid i j)) ∧
  (∃ constraints : (Fin 8 → Fin 8 → Prop), 
    (∀ i j, constraints i j → grid i j ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ i j, constraints i j → grid i j ∈ Set.range (fun k => k + 1)))

∃ (coloring : Fin 7 → Fin 3), 
  
  (∀ u v : Fin 7, 
    (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0) ∨ 
    (u = 2 ∧ v = 3) ∨ (u = 3 ∧ v = 2) ∨ 
    (u = 6 ∧ v = 4) ∨ (u = 4 ∧ v = 6) ∨ 
    (u = 6 ∧ v = 5) ∨ (u = 5 ∧ v = 6) → 
    coloring u ≠ coloring v) ∧
  
  let true_count := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => coloring i = 1)).card
  let false_count := 7 - true_count
  
  true_count ≥ 2 ∧
  
  false_count ≤ 3 ∧
  
  true_count = 4 ∧
  
  false_count = 3 ∧
  
  ((true_count = 4) ≠ (false_count = 3)) ∧
  
  Nat.Prime true_count ∧
  
  (false_count > 1 ∧ ¬Nat.Prime false_count)

∃ (grid : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℕ),
  
  (∀ i : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.image (grid i)).toSet = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}) ∧
  
  (∀ j : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.image (fun i => grid i j)).toSet = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}) ∧
  
  (∀ i : Fin 5, ∀ j k : Fin 5, j < k → grid i j < grid i k) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin 5, ∀ j k : Fin 5, j > k → grid i j > grid i k) ∧
  
  (∀ j : Fin 5, ∀ i₁ i₂ : Fin 5, i₁ < i₂ → grid i₁ j < grid i₂ j) ∧
  (∀ j : Fin 5, ∀ i₁ i₂ : Fin 5, i₁ > i₂ → grid i₁ j > grid i₂ j) ∧
  
  (∀ h : Fin 5, ∀ h_val : ℕ, grid h 0 = h_val → h_val ∈ ({1, 2, 3, 4, 5} : Set ℕ)) ∧
  
  (∃ t : Fin 5, ∃ t_val : ℕ, grid t 0 = t_val ∧ t_val ∈ ({1, 2, 3, 4, 5} : Set ℕ) ∧ 
   ¬(∃ h : Fin 5, grid h 0 = h_val)) ∧
  
  grid 1 1 = 2 ∧ grid 1 2 = 4 ∧ grid 1 3 = 3 ∧ grid 1 4 = 5 ∧
  grid 2 0 = 1 ∧ grid 2 1 = 3 ∧ grid 2 2 = 2 ∧ grid 2 3 = 4 ∧ grid 2 4 = 5 ∧
  grid 3 0 = 4 ∧ grid 3 1 = 2 ∧ grid 3 2 = 1 ∧ grid 3 3 = 3 ∧ grid 3 4 = 5 ∧
  grid 4 0 = 3 ∧ grid 4 1 = 1 ∧ grid 4 2 = 4 ∧ grid 4 3 = 2 ∧ grid 4 4 = 5

∃ (sudoku : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4) (kukurasu : Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 2),
  
  (sudoku 0 1 = 3) ∧ (sudoku 1 2 = 1) ∧ (sudoku 0 0 = 3) ∧ (sudoku 2 1 = 2) ∧ (sudoku 3 3 = 2) ∧
  
  (∀ i : Fin 4, ∀ n : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => sudoku i j = n)).card = 1) ∧
  
  (∀ j : Fin 4, ∀ n : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => sudoku i j = n)).card = 1) ∧
  
  (∀ i j : Fin 2, ∀ n : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin 2 × Fin 2 => 
    sudoku (i + p.1) (j + p.2) = n)).card = 1) ∧
  
  (∀ i j, kukurasu i j = 0 ∨ kukurasu i j = 1) ∧
  
  (∀ i : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.sum (fun j : Fin 5 => (kukurasu i j).val + 1 * (j.val + 1))) = 
    if i.val = 0 then 1
    else if i.val = 1 then 5
    else if i.val = 2 then 7
    else 5) ∧
  
  (∀ j : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin 4 => (kukurasu i j).val + 1 * (i.val + 1))) = 
    if j.val = 0 then 4
    else if j.val = 1 then 5
    else if j.val = 2 then 2
    else if j.val = 3 then 3
    else 4) ∧
  
  (∀ i j, (kukurasu i j).val = 1 ↔ sudoku i j = 1)

∃ (queen_positions : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (coloring : Fin n → Fin n → Fin 3),
    
    queen_positions.card = n ∧
    
    (∀ (p q : Fin n × Fin n), p ∈ queen_positions → q ∈ queen_positions → p ≠ q → 
      ¬(p.1 = q.1 ∨ p.2 = q.2 ∨ p.1.val + p.2.val = q.1.val + q.2.val ∨ p.1.val + p.2.val = n - 1 + q.1.val + q.2.val)) ∧
    
    (∀ (i j : Fin n), coloring i j ∈ Set.univ) ∧
    
    (∀ (i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂ : Fin n), 
      i₁.val + j₁.val = i₂.val + j₂.val ∨ i₁.val + j₁.val = n - 1 + i₂.val + j₂.val →
      coloring i₁ j₁ ≠ coloring i₂ j₂) ∧
    
    (∀ (p : Fin n × Fin n), p ∈ queen_positions → 
      ∃! (c : Fin 3), coloring p.1 p.2 = c)

∃ (owen_is_sage elizabeth_is_sage : Bool),
    
    (owen_is_sage → (elizabeth_is_sage → ¬elizabeth_is_sage)) ∧
    (elizabeth_is_sage → (owen_is_sage ↔ ¬owen_is_sage)) ∧
    
    (owen_is_sage ≠ elizabeth_is_sage) ∧
    
    (∃ (row col : Fin 8),
      
      (∀ (i : Fin 8), ∀ (j : Fin 8),
        
        (i ≠ row ∨ j ≠ col) ∧
        
        (i ≠ j → (i + j ≠ row + col) ∧ (i - j ≠ row - col))) ∧
      
      (∀ (i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂ : Fin 8),
        (i₁ ≠ i₂ ∨ j₁ ≠ j₂) →
        (i₁ + j₁ ≠ i₂ + j₂) →
        (i₁ - j₁ ≠ i₂ - j₂))) ∧
    
    (owen_is_sage ∨ elizabeth_is_sage) ∧
    (¬owen_is_sage ∨ ¬elizabeth_is_sage)

∃ (truth : Fin 7 → Bool) (grid : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Bool) (inequality : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Bool),
  
  (let count_true := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => truth i = true)).card
   let count_false := 7 - count_true
   
   (count_true ≥ 2) ∧
   
   (count_false ≤ 4) ∧
   
   (count_true = 5) ∧
   
   (countFalse = 7) ∧
   
   ((count_true = 5) ≠ (count_false = 7)) ∧
   
   (Nat.Prime count_true) ∧
   
   (¬Nat.Prime count_false ∧ count_false > 1) ∧
   
   (∃ (arrangement : Fin 7 → Fin 4 × Fin 4), 
     ∀ i, grid (arrangement i).1 (arrangement i).2 = truth i) ∧
   
   (∀ i j, inequality i j = grid i j < grid (i + 1) j ∨ grid i j > grid (i + 1) j ∨ 
                    grid i j < grid i (j + 1) ∨ grid i j > grid i (j + 1)))

∃ (grid : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℕ) (coloring : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℕ),
  
  (grid 0 0 = 3 ∧ grid 0 2 = 4 ∧ grid 0 3 = 2) ∧
  (grid 1 0 = 4 ∧ grid 1 2 = 1) ∧
  (grid 2 1 = 2 ∧ grid 2 2 = 2) ∧
  (grid 3 1 = 2) ∧
  
  (∀ i j k, grid i j = grid i k → i = j) ∧  
  (∀ i j k, grid i j = grid k j → i = k) ∧  
  (∀ i j k l, grid i j = grid k l → 
    (i = k ∧ j = l) ∨ 
    (i = k ∧ j ≠ l ∧ k < 3 ∧ l < 3 ∧ grid (i + 2) (j + 2) = grid k l) ∨
    (i ≠ k ∧ j = l ∧ k < 3 ∧ l < 3 ∧ grid (i + 2) (j + 2) = grid k l) ∨
    (i ≠ k ∧ j ≠ l ∧ k < 2 ∧ l < 2 ∧ grid (i + 2) (j + 2) = grid k l)) ∧
  
  (∀ i j, coloring i j ∈ ({1, 2, 3} : Set ℕ)) ∧
  
  (∀ i j i' j', 
    (i = i' ∨ j = j' ∨ (i.val + 2 < 4 ∧ j.val + 2 < 4 ∧ grid i j = grid (i + 2) (j + 2) ∧ grid (i + 2) (j + 2) = grid i' j')) →
    grid i j = grid i' j' → coloring i j ≠ coloring i' j')

∃ (queen_pos : Fin 8 × Fin 8) (color_assignment : Fin 8 → Fin 8 → ℕ),
    
    queen_pos ∉ queen_positions ∧
    
    (∀ pos ∈ queen_positions ∪ {queen_pos}, 
      ∀ other_pos ∈ queen_positions ∪ {queen_pos}, 
        pos ≠ other_pos → 
        ¬(pos.1 = other_pos.1 ∨ pos.2 = other_pos.2 ∨ 
          (pos.1 + 1 = other_pos.1 ∧ pos.2 + 1 = other_pos.2) ∨
          (pos.1 + 1 = other_pos.1 ∧ pos.2 - 1 = other_pos.2) ∨
          (pos.1 - 1 = other_pos.1 ∧ pos.2 + 1 = other_pos.2) ∨
          (pos.1 - 1 = other_pos.1 ∧ pos.2 - 1 = other_pos.2))) ∧
    
    (∀ i j, color_assignment i j ∈ ({1, 2, 3} : Set ℕ)) ∧
    
    (∀ i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂, 
      ((i₁ = i₂ ∧ (j₁ = j₂ ∨ j₁ + 1 = j₂ ∨ j₁ - 1 = j₂)) ∨
       (j₁ = j₂ ∧ (i₁ = i₂ ∨ i₁ + 1 = i₂ ∨ i₁ - 1 = i₂)) ∨
       (i₁ + 1 = i₂ ∧ j₁ + 1 = j₂) ∨
       (i₁ + 1 = i₂ ∧ j₁ - 1 = j₂) ∨
       (i₁ - 1 = i₂ ∧ j₁ + 1 = j₂) ∨
       (i₁ - 1 = i₂ ∧ j₁ - 1 = j₂)) →
      color_assignment i₁ j₁ ≠ color_assignment i₂ j₂) ∧
    
    (∀ pos ∈ queen_positions ∪ {queen_pos}, 
      color_assignment pos.1 pos.2 = color_assignment pos.1 pos.2)

∃ (david_is_altruist jack_is_altruist : Bool) (true_count : ℕ),
    
    (david_is_altruist ≠ jack_is_altruist) ∧
    
    (david_is_altruist → jack_is_altruist ∨ ¬jack_is_altruist) ∧
    
    (jack_is_altruist → david_is_altruist) ∧
    
    let S1 := true_count ≥ 4
    let S2 := true_count ≤ 3  
    let S3 := true_count = 4
    let S4 := true_count = 3
    let S5 := (S3 ∧ ¬S4) ∨ (¬S3 ∧ S4)
    let S6 := Nat.Prime true_count
    let S7 := ¬Nat.Prime (7 - true_count) ∧ (7 - true_count > 1)
    
    let statement_1 := S1
    let statement_2 := S2  
    let statement_3 := S3
    let statement_4 := S4
    let statement_5 := S5
    let statement_6 := S6
    let statement_7 := S7
    
    true_count = (if statement_1 then 1 else 0) + 
                 (if statement_2 then 1 else 0) + 
                 (if statement_3 then 1 else 0) + 
                 (if statement_4 then 1 else 0) + 
                 (if statement_5 then 1 else 0) + 
                 (if statement_6 then 1 else 0) + 
                 (if statement_7 then 1 else 0) ∧
    
    (david_is_altruist = true ∧ jack_is_altruist = true ∧ true_count = 4)

∃ (board : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℕ), 
  (∀ i j, board i j = 0 ∨ board i j = 1) ∧ 
  (∃ (queen_positions : Finset (Fin 5 × Fin 5)), 
    queen_positions.card = 5 ∧
    (∀ (i j : Fin 5), (i, j) ∈ queen_positions ↔ board i j = 1) ∧
    (∀ (i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂ : Fin 5), (i₁, j₁) ∈ queen_positions → (i₂, j₂) ∈ queen_positions → 
      (i₁, j₁) ≠ (i₂, j₂) → ¬(i₁ = i₂ ∨ j₁ = j₂ ∨ i₁ + j₁ = i₂ + j₂ ∨ i₁ + j₁ = 4 - i₂ - j₂)) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => board i j = 1)).sum (fun j => j.val + 1) = 
      match i with
      | 0 => 10
      | 1 => 4  
      | 2 => 5
      | 3 => 1
      | 4 => 11) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => board i j = 1)).sum (fun i => i.val + 1) = 
      match j with
      | 0 => 5
      | 1 => 9
      | 2 => 4
      | 3 => 8
      | 4 => 5))

∃! (grid : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Bool),
    
    
    let row_weight (i : Fin 5) : ℕ := i.val + 1
    let col_weight (j : Fin 5) : ℕ := j.val + 1
    let row_sum (i : Fin 5) : ℕ := ∑ j : Fin 5, (if grid i j then col_weight j else 0)
    let col_sum (j : Fin 5) : ℕ := ∑ i : Fin 5, (if grid i j then row_weight i else 0)
    
    
    
    
    (∀ i j, grid i j → grid i j) ∧ 
    (∀ i j, grid i j → ¬grid i j ∨ grid i j) ∧
    
    (∀ i : Fin 5, row_sum i ≥ 1 ∧ row_sum i ≤ 5) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 5, col_sum j ≥ 1 ∧ col_sum j ≤ 5) ∧
    
    (∃ (solution : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Bool), 
      solution = grid ∧
      (∀ i j, solution i j → solution i j) ∧
      (∀ i j, solution i j → ¬solution i j ∨ solution i j) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 5, (∑ j : Fin 5, (if solution i j then (j.val + 1) else 0)) ≥ 1 ∧ 
                    (∑ j : Fin 5, (if solution i j then (j.val + 1) else 0)) ≤ 5) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 5, (∑ i : Fin 5, (if solution i j then (i.val + 1) else 0)) ≥ 1 ∧ 
                    (∑ i : Fin 5, (if solution i j then (i.val + 1) else 0)) ≤ 5))

∃ (coloring : Fin 10 → ℕ) (true_count false_count : ℕ),
  
  (∀ v : Fin 10, coloring v ∈ ({1, 2, 3} : Set ℕ)) ∧
  
  (∀ u v : Fin 10, (u, v) ∈ ({(1, 7), (1, 8), (5, 7)} : Set (Fin 10 × Fin 10)) → coloring u ≠ coloring v) ∧
  
  true_count + false_count = 10 ∧
  
  let statement1 := true_count ≥ 4
  let statement2 := false_count ≤ 2  
  let statement3 := true_count = 2
  let statement4 := false_count = 1
  let statement5 := (statement3 ∧ ¬statement4) ∨ (¬statement3 ∧ statement4)
  let statement6 := Nat.Prime true_count
  let statement7 := ¬Nat.Prime false_count ∧ false_count > 1
  
  (statement1 ∧ statement2 ∧ statement3 ∧ statement4 ∧ statement5 ∧ statement6 ∧ statement7) ∧
  
  true_count + false_count = 10 ∧
  
  (∃ (count1 count2 count3 : ℕ), 
    count1 + count2 + count3 = 10 ∧
    (∀ v : Fin 10, coloring v = 1 → count1 > 0) ∧
    (∀ v : Fin 10, coloring v = 2 → count2 > 0) ∧  
    (∀ v : Fin 10, coloring v = 3 → count3 > 0) ∧
    true_count = count1 ∧ false_count = count2 + count3)

∃ (grid : Fin 4 → Fin 5 → ℕ) (victoria_is_sage grace_is_sage : Bool),
    
    (∀ i j, grid i j = 0 ∨ grid i j = 1) ∧
    
    (∑ j, grid 0 j * (j.val + 1) = 3) ∧
    (∑ j, grid 1 j * (j.val + 1) = 4) ∧
    (∑ j, grid 2 j * (j.val + 1) = 10) ∧
    (∑ j, grid 3 j * (j.val + 1) = 3) ∧
    
    (∑ i, grid i 0 * (i.val + 1) = 4) ∧
    (∑ i, grid i 1 * (i.val + 1) = 7) ∧
    (∑ i, grid i 2 * (i.val + 1) = 4) ∧
    (∑ i, grid i 3 * (i.val + 1) = 2) ∧
    (∑ i, grid i 4 * (i.val + 1) = 3) ∧
    
    (victoria_is_sage → (∀ x, x ↔ (grid 0 0 = 1 ∧ grid 0 1 = 1 ∧ grid 1 2 = 1 ∧ grid 3 3 = 1))) ∧
    (grace_is_sage → (victoria_is_sage ∧ grace_is_sage)) ∧
    (¬victoria_is_sage → ¬(victoria_is_sage → (grid 0 0 = 1 ∧ grid 0 1 = 1 ∧ grid 1 2 = 1 ∧ grid 3 3 = 1))) ∧
    (¬grace_is_sage → ¬(victoria_is_sage ∧ grace_is_sage)) ∧
    
    (victoria_is_sage ∧ ¬grace_is_sage) ∧
    (grid 0 0 = 1 ∧ grid 0 1 = 1 ∧ grid 0 2 = 0 ∧ grid 0 3 = 0 ∧ grid 0 4 = 1) ∧
    (grid 1 0 = 0 ∧ grid 1 1 = 1 ∧ grid 1 2 = 1 ∧ grid 1 3 = 0 ∧ grid 1 4 = 0) ∧
    (grid 2 0 = 0 ∧ grid 2 1 = 0 ∧ grid 2 2 = 1 ∧ grid 2 3 = 1 ∧ grid 2 4 = 1) ∧
    (grid 3 0 = 1 ∧ grid 3 1 = 0 ∧ grid 3 2 = 0 ∧ grid 3 3 = 1 ∧ grid 3 4 = 0)

∃ (clara_is_saint daniel_is_saint : Bool),
    
    (clara_is_saint → ∀ s : Bool, s → (s ∧ ¬s) = False) ∧
    
    (daniel_is_saint → (clara_is_saint ↔ ¬daniel_is_saint)) ∧

    (cats ⊆ birds) → 
    (birds ⊆ ants) → 
    (birds.Nonempty) → 
    (ants ∩ birds).Nonempty)

(∃ (grid : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℕ),
    
    
    grid 0 0 = 2 ∧
    
    (∀ i : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.image (grid i)).toSet = {1, 2, 3, 4}) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 4, (Finset.univ.image (fun i => grid i j)).toSet = {1, 2, 3, 4}) ∧
    (∀ i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ : Fin 2,
